handedness.visual_basis: From FO and DTL at address (tick 15) the golfer's left side is closer to target (lead side left), typical right-handed setup.

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Address posture with club behind ball and no visible motion; hands steady at hip/thigh level.
Hands and club have lifted away from the ball relative to address; clubshaft rising.
Continued upward/backward motion of hands and club; backswing progressing.
Near top of backswing; hands high and behind head.
Hands at or near top and beginning to change direction downward toward ball (club starting forward).
Hands and club clearly moving downward/toward the ball in impact zone frames.
Continued movement toward the ball; hands approaching impact position.
Follow-through frames after impact with club past ball and body turning to finish.
